intent: Record as reviewed the proposal, finding, report, spend and note rules the operations Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context operations lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A platform agent conclusion that proposes an action outside its definition's action list fails as a whole, so nothing is recorded.
A proposal whose preview counts are all zero is dropped and never reaches an operator.
A new proposal is skipped while another proposal for the same action is proposed, approved or running.
An operator may move a finding only along the allowed status paths; any other move is refused.
After a successful report, every open or acknowledged finding the report did not cite becomes recovered, and reopens if a later report cites it.
A daily report item or proposal that cites no fact, or cites a pointer no tool result holds, is rejected.
A platform agent run with unpriced steps counts toward the daily cap at least the budget its gateway key was given.
Enabling or disabling an agent, changing its spend cap or its brake is refused with 400 when the note is blank.
A run halted while the brake is engaged stops with the brake's reason even when the agent is also disabled.
